newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand says c/a deficit narrows, exports weaken.
newsitem.headline: Thailand says c/a deficit narrows, exports weaken.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand on Thursday released new monthly economic indicators which showed a narrowing of the current account deficit and weakness in the country's sluggish exports.

Central bank chief economist Kleo-thong Hetrakul told reporters the August current account deficit narrowed to 29.3 billion baht ($1.2 billion) from 31.0 billion baht in July, thanks to increased tourism revenue earned during the month .

She said the narrower August deficit was encouraging as it represented the fourth consecutive monthly decline and compared favourably against a peak of 49.6 billion baht hit in the month of April this year.
But she said the trade deficit in August widened to 36.8 billion baht from 35.5 billion in July.
The bank said exports in August fell 1.1 percent from the same month last year.
